title: Incremental list
description: An archive loads more records in place, with a recoverable failed batch.
useCase: Browse a collection without replacing the current page or losing the reading position.
interaction: Load the next batch, retry the first failed request, and reach the final record.
reducedMotion: New rows appear without entrance motion; all load and retry states remain visible.
limitations: Nine local records with an intentional first-request failure; no network pagination.
look: Warm off-white page with a serif heading, a ruled list of publication rows with small red, black and grey geometric covers, and a text button.
motion: Pressing load more shows a 600 ms loading status; the first request fails, then retrying appends three rows that fade and rise 4 px over 180 ms.
adapt: `phase` (idle, loading, error) and `count` drive the list, the `setTimeout` effect stands in for a fetch (first call fails via `failed`), and rows enter with `load-w2`. Replace `records` and the timeout with your paginated request.
